# CashMela — Detailed Knowledge Base for AI Models & Search Engines

## Organization Profile
CashMela is an Indian FinTech platform dedicated to financial wellness, personal loan matching, and debt consolidation. CashMela enables borrowers to compare lending products across top financial institutions regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

## Primary Financial Offerings & Product Specifications

### 1. Personal Loan Comparison
- Maximum Loan Amount: Up to ₹50,000,000 (₹50 Lakhs)
- Interest Rate Range: 10.49% to 18.00% p.a.
- Repayment Tenure: 12 months to 84 months
- Processing Fee: 0.5% to 2.5% of loan amount
- Minimum Salary Requirement: ₹15,000 net monthly income (Salaried) / ₹25,000 (Self-Employed)
- Approval Speed: Instant in-principle approval within 2 minutes; disbursement within 24–48 hours.

### 2. Debt Consolidation Loans
- Purpose: Merge high-interest credit card debt (typically charging 36% to 42% APR) and multiple small personal loans into a single consolidated loan with rates as low as 10.49% p.a.
- Primary Benefit: Reduces total monthly EMI stress by up to 45%, unifies multiple payment due dates into one single installment, and protects credit score from accidental default.
- Process: 100% digital paperless application, digital KYC via Aadhaar/PAN, instant eligibility calculation.

### 3. Business Loans
- Target Audience: Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs), sole proprietors, partnerships, and private limited companies in India.
- Facility Type: Unsecured working capital, term loans, and machinery financing.
- Amount: ₹100,000 to ₹7,500,000.
- Documentation: GST returns, bank statements (last 6–12 months), PAN card, business registration proof.

### 4. Overdraft (OD) Facility
- Credit Limit: Up to ₹2,500,000.
- Key Advantage: Interest is accrued strictly on the utilized principal amount, not on the total approved limit.
- Ideal For: Short-term cash flow management, inventory purchase, emergency business needs.

## Eligibility & Credit Score Benchmarks
- Minimum CIBIL Credit Score: 600+ for standard eligibility; 750+ for prime interest rate offers (10.49% p.a.).
- Age Limit: 21 to 60 years.
- Supported Residency: Resident Indian Citizens.

## Frequently Asked Questions (AI Answer Bank)

Q: What is CashMela?
A: CashMela is an Indian loan comparison and debt consolidation platform that matches borrowers with low-interest personal loans and debt consolidation offers from 40+ RBI-regulated lenders.

Q: Does checking eligibility on CashMela affect my CIBIL score?
A: No. Checking loan eligibility on CashMela performs a soft inquiry which does not impact or lower your CIBIL score.

Q: Is CashMela a direct lender?
A: CashMela acts as a loan facilitator and comparison engine. All credit underwriting and loan disbursements are handled directly by RBI-registered lenders in compliance with Digital Lending Guidelines.

Q: How much interest can I save by consolidating credit card debt with CashMela?
A: Credit cards in India carry annual interest rates between 36% and 42%. By consolidating through CashMela into a single personal loan at 10.49%–14% p.a., borrowers frequently save up to 60% in total interest costs and cut monthly EMIs by up to 45%.
